# Provider outage causes degraded operation with warnings

If an LLM provider raises an LLMProviderError (simulated outage), the compile degrades instead of failing, emitting warnings. This preserves deterministic compilation results but may silently reduce semantic coverage.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_llm_layer.py` — `tests.test_llm_layer.test_provider_failure_degrades_not_fails`
